rfam.comment: RNAs can be post-transcriptional modified, in micro RNAs (miRNA) editing of pre-mRNA is a common process. The structure of the mir-2985 has been reported in complex with ADAR protein [3] where they call it R/G site, in the structure, reported in PDB 2L3J, R/G site is reported as a regular A-form helix structure, composed of a stem-loop containing three base-pair mismatches, 2 C:A and 1 G:G. Based on the sequences presented in the SEED alignment, one of the C:A mismatches reported in [3] was updated to a a:u base pair. This family represents the microRNA (miRNA) precursor mir-2985 imported from miRBase [4].
